title: M4 Replay Detection Output Event (Proposed)
description: Structured output emitted by M4 detector upon inspecting message metadata.

replay_suspected.description: True if any replay or ordering anomalies are detected.

reasons.description: Detailed machine-readable reason codes (e.g. duplicate_sequence, lower_sequence, stale_timestamp).

sequence_number.description: Sequence number of evaluated message, or null if unparseable.

event_timestamp.description: Claimed Unix timestamp from payload, or null if missing.

observed_at.description: Unix timestamp when M4 inspected the message.
